description: PROPOSED immutable draft 2020-12 schemas; C:38–53,115–125,171–175. All object shapes closed and required. Freeze v2 §4 defines binding validation beyond JSON Schema: canonical hashes, authentication, reference resolution without cycles, state arithmetic, current observations, containment and durability are mandatory semantic checks. These schemas and catalog are static design, no real-pair acceptance.

ID.description: PROPOSED; C:38–49,115–125. Retained-history unique identity; host/boot/epoch bindings use exact equality.

Hash.description: PROPOSED; C:38–49,115–125. Canonical JSON hashing is freeze §8; raw-byte hashes are explicitly labelled.

U64.description: PROPOSED; C:38–49,115–125. Integer only; arithmetic overflow refuses.

Path.description: PROPOSED; C:38–49,115–125. Semantic validation additionally rejects traversal, expansion, non-normalization and symlink escape; equal frozen profile path.

UTC.description: PROPOSED; C:38–49,115–125. Human annotation only; real calendar validity checked; never authority clock.
